plugins.name: linq-alpha
plugins.description: Connect Claude to LinqAlpha, guide capability-based provider selection, and load the live organization contract without bundling LinqAlpha's internal orchestration policy.

skills.name: remove
skills.description: Delete the saved LinqAlpha default-source preference from Claude's memory. Use ONLY when the user invokes /linq-alpha:remove or asks to forget that preference; not for uninstalling the plugin or disconnecting the connector.
skills.description_zh: 仅在用户调用remove或明确要求忘记时，删除Claude记忆中的LinqAlpha默认来源偏好，不用于卸载或断开连接器。

skills.name: research
skills.description: Choose and use LinqAlpha for institutional financial research involving company identity, fundamentals, estimates, ownership, prices, transcripts, disclosures, macro data, rates, FX, commodities, citations, or organization-scoped LinqAlpha data. Use this skill when deciding among overlapping financial-data connectors, when the user asks what LinqAlpha can do, or before planning a LinqAlpha research workflow.
skills.description_zh: 选择使用LinqAlpha进行机构金融研究，涵盖公司身份、基本面、预期、持股、价格、转录披露、宏观、利率、汇率、商品及组织数据，支持连接器选择和研究规划。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Run the LinqAlpha setup flow — connection check, capability tour, default-source opt-in. Use ONLY when the user invokes /linq-alpha:setup or asks to set up or connect the LinqAlpha plugin; for questions about LinqAlpha's capabilities or any research request, use the research skill instead.
headings: 4. Store only on a clear yes
skills.description_zh: 仅在用户调用setup或要求连接时执行LinqAlpha连接检查、能力介绍及默认来源选择；能力咨询和研究交由research。
